name: Omni Barton Creek Resort & Spa
insider_take: This sprawling Hill Country sanctuary sits on 4,000 acres where championship golf meets Texas-sized luxury, just 20 minutes from downtown Austin's music scene.
whats_special: Home to four championship golf courses designed by legends like Tom Fazio and Crenshaw & Coore, plus the renowned Mokara Spa featuring treatments inspired by Texas botanicals. The resort's position in the Texas Hill Country offers stunning limestone cliff views and access to some of the region's best hiking trails.
pro_tip: Book tee times for the Fazio Foothills course at sunrise – you'll have cooler temperatures and breathtaking views as the mist rises over the Hill Country valleys.
dont_miss: The resort's famous Sunday brunch at the Clubhouse Grille overlooking the golf course, and the nearby Salt Traders Coastal Cooking for Gulf Coast cuisine. Take the scenic drive along nearby Ranch Road 2244 for quintessential Texas Hill Country photo ops.
pros: Championship golf courses and extensive recreational facilities
Full-service spa with comprehensive wellness treatments
Beautiful Hill Country setting with scenic views
Multiple dining venues and resort amenities
cons: Resort location requires transportation to downtown Austin
Premium pricing for resort amenities and services
